title: Blackbox Performance Analysis of LLM-based Network Control
abstract: arXiv:2610.24348v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLMs are becoming an indispensable part of network control systems due to their impressive reasoning. Before such LLM-enabled systems can be deployed, it is imperative to develop tools that can audit their performance on previously unseen inputs. However, auditing these systems is challenging due to the inherent opacity of LLMs. LENS is the first step towards black-box performance analysis of LLM-enabled network control systems. It uses novel methods to extend deep reinforcement learning to guide the search for performance gaps and inputs that make LLMs struggle. LENS finds large gaps for LLM-based traffic engineering and GPU allocation systems, and even matches existing white-box analyzers designed for hand-crafted TE heuristics.

translated_title: 基于大语言模型的网络控制的黑盒性能分析
translated_abstract: 由于出色的推理能力，大语言模型（LLM）正成为网络控制系统中不可或缺的组成部分。在此类基于LLM的系统部署之前，必须开发能够审计其在未见过的输入上性能的工具。然而，由于LLM固有的不透明性，审计这些系统极具挑战性。LENS是迈向基于LLM的网络控制系统黑盒性能分析的第一步。它使用新颖的方法扩展深度强化学习，以引导搜索性能差距以及使LLM陷入困境的输入。LENS在基于LLM的流量工程和GPU分配系统中发现了巨大的性能差距，其表现甚至可以媲美现有的、为手工设计的流量工程启发式方法而构建的白盒分析器。
tldr: 本文提出LENS——首个面向基于大语言模型的网络控制系统的黑盒性能分析工具，通过扩展深度强化学习来搜索性能差距和使LLM表现不佳的输入，并在流量工程和GPU分配系统中发现了显著的性能差距。
en_tdlr: This paper presents LENS, the first black-box performance analysis tool for LLM-based network control systems, which extends deep reinforcement learning to uncover performance gaps and challenging inputs, revealing large gaps in LLM-based traffic engineering and GPU allocation systems.
